name: Migueláñez (Spain)
description: Square green flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Migueláñez (crosses and a crozier on yellow and the aqueduct on red).
history: The arms and flag of Migueláñez were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 27 May 1998; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, green with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre of the cloth.
